mapper.sql: (l.nominal, l.lsl, l.usl, l.unit_nm, l.scale, l.special_cls, l.data_type) is distinct from (ch.nominal, ch.lsl, ch.usl, ch.unit_nm, ch.scale, ch.special_cls, ch.data_type)

p.insp_plan_id, p.insp_type, p.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.use_yn as item_use_yn, p.item_class_id, c.class_cd, c.class_nm, c.use_yn as class_use_yn, p.proc_id, pr.proc_cd, pr.proc_nm, pr.use_yn as proc_use_yn, coalesce(i.item_cd, c.class_cd) as target_cd, coalesce(i.item_nm, c.class_nm) as target_nm, p.alt_no, p.rev, p.status, p.valid_from, p.valid_to, p.change_no, p.change_reason, p.remark, p.released_at, p.released_by, p.row_ver, p.updated_at, p.updated_by, p.doc_rev_id, (select d.doc_no || ' / ' || r.rev from mst_doc_rev r join mst_doc d on d.doc_id = r.doc_id where r.doc_rev_id = p.doc_rev_id) as doc_label, (select r.status from mst_doc_rev r where r.doc_rev_id = p.doc_rev_id) as doc_rev_status, (select count(*) from qms_insp_plan_line l where l.insp_plan_id = p.insp_plan_id) as line_cnt, case when p.status = 'RELEASED' then (select count(*) from qms_insp_plan_line l join qms_char ch on ch.char_id = l.char_id where l.insp_plan_id = p.insp_plan_id and ) else 0 end as spec_changed_cnt
from qms_insp_plan p left join mst_item i on i.item_id = p.item_id left join mst_item_class c on c.class_id = p.item_class_id left join mst_proc pr on pr.proc_id = p.proc_id

where.if: and (coalesce(i.item_cd, c.class_cd) ilike #{q.targetLike} escape '\' or coalesce(i.item_nm, c.class_nm) ilike #{q.targetLike} escape '\')
and p.status = 'RELEASED' and exists ( select 1 from qms_insp_plan_line l join qms_char ch on ch.char_id = l.char_id where l.insp_plan_id = p.insp_plan_id and )

mapper.sql:
order by
p.insp_type coalesce(i.item_cd, c.class_cd) pr.proc_cd p.rev p.status p.valid_from p.updated_at
desc,
p.insp_plan_id
mapper.select: select p.rev from qms_insp_plan p where
select p.insp_plan_id from qms_insp_plan p where and p.status = 'DRAFT'

insert into qms_insp_plan (comp_cd, insp_type, item_id, item_class_id, proc_id, alt_no, rev, valid_from, change_no, change_reason, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.inspType}, #{f.itemId}, #{f.itemClassId}, #{f.procId}, #{f.altNo}, #{f.rev}, #{f.validFrom}, #{f.changeNo}, #{f.changeReason}, #{f.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning insp_plan_id
mapper.update: update qms_insp_plan set doc_rev_id = #{docRevId}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where insp_plan_id = #{id} and status = 'DRAFT' and row_ver = #{rowVer}

update qms_insp_plan t set doc_rev_id = (select s.doc_rev_id from qms_insp_plan s join mst_doc_rev r on r.doc_rev_id = s.doc_rev_id where s.insp_plan_id = #{fromId} and r.status <> 'OBSOLETE') where t.insp_plan_id = #{toId} and t.status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: select r.doc_rev_id, d.doc_no, d.doc_nm, r.rev, r.status from mst_doc_rev r join mst_doc d on d.doc_id = r.doc_id where d.doc_type = 'INSP_STD' and d.use_yn = 'Y' and r.status <> 'OBSOLETE' order by d.doc_no, r.doc_rev_id desc limit 1000
mapper.update: update qms_insp_plan set row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where insp_plan_id = #{id} and status = 'DRAFT' and row_ver = #{rowVer}
mapper.select: select where and p.status = 'RELEASED' and p.insp_plan_id <> #{exceptId} and daterange(p.valid_from, p.valid_to, '[)') && daterange(cast(#{from} as date), null, '[)') order by p.valid_from
mapper.update: update qms_insp_plan set valid_to = #{validTo}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where insp_plan_id = #{id} and status = 'RELEASED'
update qms_insp_plan set status = 'OBSOLETE', row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where insp_plan_id = #{id} and status in ('DRAFT', 'RELEASED') and row_ver = #{rowVer}
mapper.select: select l.line_id, l.insp_plan_id, l.line_no, l.char_id, ch.char_type, ch.char_no, ch.char_nm, ch.use_yn as char_use_yn, ci.item_cd as char_item_cd, cp.proc_cd as char_proc_cd, l.method_nm, l.gauge_class, l.sampling_plan_id, s.plan_cd as sampling_plan_cd, s.plan_nm as sampling_plan_nm, s.use_yn as sampling_use_yn, l.freq_type, l.freq_n, l.reaction_plan, l.remark, l.grp_nm, l.evidence_req, case when p.status = 'DRAFT' then ch.nominal else l.nominal end as nominal, case when p.status = 'DRAFT' then ch.lsl else l.lsl end as lsl, case when p.status = 'DRAFT' then ch.usl else l.usl end as usl, case when p.status = 'DRAFT' then ch.unit_nm else l.unit_nm end as unit_nm, case when p.status = 'DRAFT' then ch.scale else l.scale end as scale, case when p.status = 'DRAFT' then ch.special_cls else l.special_cls end as special_cls, case when p.status = 'DRAFT' then ch.data_type else l.data_type end as data_type, (p.status = 'RELEASED' and ) as spec_changed, ch.nominal as cur_nominal, ch.lsl as cur_lsl, ch.usl as cur_usl, ch.unit_nm as cur_unit_nm, ch.scale as cur_scale, ch.data_type as cur_data_type, l.row_ver from qms_insp_plan_line l join qms_insp_plan p on p.insp_plan_id = l.insp_plan_id join qms_char ch on ch.char_id = l.char_id left join mst_item ci on ci.item_id = ch.item_id left join mst_proc cp on cp.proc_id = ch.proc_id join qms_sampling_plan s on s.sampling_plan_id = l.sampling_plan_id where l.insp_plan_id = #{planId} order by l.line_no, l.line_id

insert into qms_insp_plan_line (comp_cd, insp_plan_id, line_no, char_id, method_nm, gauge_class, sampling_plan_id, freq_type, freq_n, reaction_plan, remark, grp_nm, evidence_req, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{planId}, #{l.lineNo}, #{l.charId}, #{l.methodNm}, #{l.gaugeClass}, #{l.samplingPlanId}, #{l.freqType}, #{l.freqN}, #{l.reactionPlan}, #{l.remark}, #{l.grpNm}, #{l.evidenceReq}, #{by}, #{by}) returning line_id
mapper.delete: delete from qms_insp_plan_line where line_id = #{lineId} and insp_plan_id = #{planId}
mapper.select: select item_id, item_cd, item_nm, item_class_id, use_yn from mst_item where item_cd = #{itemCd}
select class_id as id, class_cd as cd, class_nm as nm, use_yn from mst_item_class where class_cd = #{classCd}
select proc_id as id, proc_cd as cd, proc_nm as nm, use_yn from mst_proc where proc_cd = #{procCd}
select class_id as id, class_cd as cd, class_nm as nm, use_yn from mst_item_class where use_yn = 'Y' order by sort_no, class_cd
select proc_id as id, proc_cd as cd, proc_nm as nm, use_yn from mst_proc where use_yn = 'Y' order by sort_no, proc_cd
mapper.sql: ch.char_id, ch.char_type, ch.item_id, ch.proc_id, ch.char_no, ch.char_nm, i.item_cd, pr.proc_cd, ch.data_type, ch.unit_nm, ch.scale, ch.nominal, ch.lsl, ch.usl, ch.special_cls, ch.use_yn
mapper.select: select from qms_char ch left join mst_item i on i.item_id = ch.item_id left join mst_proc pr on pr.proc_id = ch.proc_id where ch.use_yn = 'Y' and ((ch.item_id is not null and ch.item_id = cast(#{itemId} as bigint)) or (ch.item_id is null and (cast(#{procId} as bigint) is null or ch.proc_id = cast(#{procId} as bigint)))) order by case when ch.item_id is not null then 0 else 1 end, pr.proc_cd nulls first, ch.sort_no, ch.char_no
select from qms_char ch left join mst_item i on i.item_id = ch.item_id left join mst_proc pr on pr.proc_id = ch.proc_id where ch.char_id = #{charId}

select insp_plan_id, insp_type, item_id, item_class_id, proc_id, alt_no, rev, status, valid_from, valid_to from qms_insp_plan where status = 'RELEASED' and insp_type = #{inspType} and (item_id = #{itemId} or item_class_id = cast(#{classId} as bigint))
